note: Nets driven by continuous assigns whose index is not an integer literal: a for generate that leaves bit 3 of a net undriven, a for generate plus one more driver on bit 1, and a parameter as the index of one of two drivers of a bit. Once a for generate is expanded its index is a bit string, and a parameter is a name; neither was read as the constant it is, so the nets were lowered to processes: bit 3 read x where the source reads z, and the two drivers of a bit no longer resolved. Found in review of the hif-frontend change that keeps continuous assigns that carry net semantics (hif-backend#88, #104); 149 to 400 of 400 vectors differed. Behavioral against the design's own source, with the enables and the second driver exercised in every combination.
